legal.privacy_intro: Reflex is committed to safeguarding your privacy and ensuring transparency regarding how your data is handled.
legal.privacy_section1_body: We collect information you provide directly, including your name, email address, profile picture (if uploaded), and study preferences. When practicing flashcards, we record your response latency, answers, and spaced repetition intervals to adaptively schedule reviews.
legal.privacy_section2_body: If you sign in using Google or Apple, we receive your verified identifier and email address in accordance with their privacy policies. We never share your learning history or personal credentials with advertisers.
legal.privacy_section3_body: You have full ownership of your data. You may permanently delete your account and all associated attempts, review schedules, and profile images at any time directly within the app under Settings > Delete Account.
legal.privacy_section4_body: All network communication is encrypted using TLS/HTTPS. Passwords and session tokens are hashed and secured in compliance with standard mobile data safety standards (Google Play & Apple App Store guidelines).
legal.terms_section1_body: By accessing or using Reflex, you agree to be bound by these Terms of Service and all applicable laws and regulations.
legal.terms_section2_body: All educational flashcards, concepts, and teacher notes provided on Reflex are for individual learning or approved classroom study. Automated scraping or reverse engineering is prohibited.
legal.terms_section3_body: Users must not upload abusive content, attempt unauthorized server access, or compromise the learning platform for other students.
legal.terms_section4_body: You may terminate your account at any time. We reserve the right to suspend accounts that violate educational integrity or community guidelines.
